The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Project Associate: Fresh Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering with minimum 5 years relevant research or industrial experience. Experience in CFD for multiphase flow simulations required.

content_sections.heading: Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Senior Project Associate: Rs. 75000 Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras), a premier government institution located in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post for this recruitment drive is Senior Project Associate, offering a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position under this IIT Madras recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications for the Senior Project Associate post is 11 August 2026. Candidates should apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for the Senior Project Associate positions. The application process is entirely digital.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Project Associate post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 75000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering or an M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates, for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates, followed by a test/interview, and finally document verification for selected candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Project Associate post is Chennai, Tamil Nadu, within the campus of IIT Madras.
